name: branding-embossed-crest-perfume-packaging-and-gift-card
title: Blind-embossed crest on cream perfume box and diamond-shaped gift card
whatItIs: A split image. Left, a cream perfume box with diagonal type and an embossed octagonal crest with radiating lines, set on lilac and black stock with matching crests debossed in purple, black and grey. Right, a black background with a diamond-shaped embossed gift card whose letters 'GIFT CARD' are arranged in a cross around the centre.
whatItMeans: Luxurious and quiet; texture and shadow do the talking, so the brand feels collectable and precious.
techniques: Emboss or deboss a symbol so the mark is felt and lit by shadow.
Set type at an angle along the box edge for an editorial look.
Colour-shift the same crest across purple, black and grey stocks.
Arrange the letters of a phrase into a cross around a central mark.

vocabulary.definition: A raised design pressed into paper without ink.
A design pressed into the surface.
Letters placed in a plus-shaped arrangement.
